source_audit.reviewer: benchmark curator model, full source review
source_audit.notes: Full source reviewed: original BF16 weights and FP32 router retained, with explicitly permitted BF16 hi/lo router repack and FP32 partial sums. Kernels read current inputs and full K dimensions; only shape/configuration-dependent dispatch and lossless layouts. Mixed input types in multi-token router kernels still require actual compilation/correctness checks. No harness, module, timing, network or source access.

scope: Full public-shape, fresh-seed local benchmark; not an official OKC score.
